# Buy Land In Peru

> Buy Land In Peru helps people from other countries find, check and buy property in Peru safely, at the local price. It is run by Lucas, a US and Peruvian citizen who lives on his own land about 3.5 km outside Lamas, San Martín, in Peru's high jungle, and who has bought land there himself.

Key facts:

- Region: based in Lamas, San Martín (near Tarapoto). Scouts land in San Martín in person; gives honest advice about other regions.
- Services: "A slice of the rainforest" (small plots, from USD 500 flat fee), "The search" (from USD 1,000 plus success fee), "Start to finish" (remote purchase help, from USD 2,000 plus success fee). The first three clients pay expenses only.
- Safety: purchase money is held in a bank trust (fideicomiso) or by the notary, never by Lucas. Title is registered with SUNARP in the buyer's name. A licensed Peruvian attorney handles the legal side. Lucas is not a lawyer.
- Foreigners can own property in Peru, except within 50 km of an international border without special authorization.
- Contact: info@buylandinperu.com (email only, free first call). Listings and prices are subject to change.

## Service

- [Buy Land in Peru as a Foreigner | Local Help in Lamas & Tarapoto](https://buylandinperu.com/): Lucas lives on his own land outside Lamas, San Martín, and helps people abroad find, check and buy property in Peru safely, at the local price, even buying remotely.
- [How to Buy Land in Peru as a Foreigner: 5 Steps](https://buylandinperu.com/how-it-works.html): From a free first call to title in your name: scouting, SUNARP title checks, negotiating in Spanish at the local price, and a safe notary closing with funds held in trust.
- [Services & Pricing: Help Buying Property in Peru](https://buylandinperu.com/services.html): Three ways to work together: a slice of the rainforest from $500, a full property search from $1,000, or start-to-finish remote purchase help from $2,000.
- [About Lucas: US & Peruvian Citizen Living Near Lamas, Peru](https://buylandinperu.com/about.html): A US and Peruvian citizen, Lucas bought land outside Lamas in 2021. Here's how he bought it, what went wrong, and why he now helps others buy land in Peru.
- [Buying Property in Peru: FAQ for Foreigners](https://buylandinperu.com/faq.html): Can foreigners own land in Peru? Who holds the money? Can you buy remotely? Honest answers about ownership, the 50 km border rule, costs, timelines and fees.
- [Contact Lucas | Free First Call About Buying Land in Peru](https://buylandinperu.com/contact.html): Send a message or email info@buylandinperu.com to book a free, no-obligation first call about buying property in Peru.

## Guides

- [Where to Buy Land in Peru: 11 Regions Compared](https://buylandinperu.com/guides/regions.html): Tarapoto, Lamas, Lima, Cusco, Arequipa, the Sacred Valley, Iquitos and more: climate, daily life and the infrastructure listings skip.
- [How Buying Property in Peru Works: SUNARP, Title & the 50 km Rule](https://buylandinperu.com/guides/buying-basics.html): Due diligence for foreign buyers: the border rule, SUNARP certificates, possession vs. title, who must sign, fraud red flags and remote purchases.
- [Peruvian Real Estate Glossary: Spanish Property Terms Explained](https://buylandinperu.com/guides/glossary.html): Alcabala, partida registral, minuta, poder, SUNARP and 50 more Spanish terms from a Peruvian property purchase, explained in plain English.
